nursing_program.name: Technical Baccalaureate in General Nursing
nursing_program.description: A dual-purpose upper-secondary education institution. Constructivist, student-centered educational model. Lasts six semesters, integrating scientific, clinical, and humanistic training.
components: Academic training in Technical Nursing Baccalaureate
Training in first aid and basic care
Human development and holistic education programs

diplomas.name: Diploma in Physical Therapy for the Hospitalized Patient
diplomas.objective: Upon completion, the physical therapist will be able to design an evaluation, diagnosis, and intervention model integrated into the multidisciplinary care of the hospitalized patient, based on up-to-date scientific evidence and national and international clinical practice guidelines.

diplomas.name: Diploma in Psychosocial Support in Medical Emergencies and Disasters
diplomas.objective: Upon completion, the participant will be able to design a psychosocial evaluation and intervention model for emergency and disaster situations, promoting emotional well-being, self-care, and resilience.

diplomas.name: Diploma in Respiratory Physical Therapy
diplomas.description: Learn physiotherapeutic intervention techniques for patients with respiratory diagnoses and complications.

red_conocer_certifications.name: Basic Prehospital Care
red_conocer_certifications.objective: Evaluate and certify people who provide basic prehospital care (emergency medical care, transport, and patient handoff).

red_conocer_certifications.name: First Aid
red_conocer_certifications.objective: Serve as a benchmark for the evaluation and certification of people who provide first-aid care.

state_level.description: Renew by accumulating points through courses taken within EDOMEX and Mexico City.

national_level.description: Renewal follows nationally established guidelines through the accumulation of points earned in courses.

state_update_program.target_audience: People who need to update or regularize their basic-level certificate
state_update_program.start_dates: No fixed dates, can start immediately

state_update_program.target_audience: People who want to update or strengthen their advanced-level certificate
state_update_program.start_dates: No fixed dates, can start immediately

courses.name: Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS)
courses.objective: Provide knowledge of the main cardiovascular pathologies and advanced resuscitation management: advanced airway management, CPR, high-performance teams, arrhythmia interpretation, and electrical and pharmacological therapy.
courses.affiliation_note: Cruz Roja EDOMEX is a training site affiliated with CEI Asesores en Emergencias y Desastres. TS59404

courses.name: Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS)
courses.objective: Learn to perform a systematic evaluation of the pediatric patient using the pediatric assessment triangle to make differential diagnoses of potential causes of emergency in these patients.

courses.name: Basic Life Support (BLS)
courses.objective: Get certified in identifying cardiorespiratory arrest and performing high-quality CPR for adults, children, and infants.
courses.affiliation_note: The Mexican Red Cross EDOMEX Training Site is affiliated with CEI Asesores en Emergencias y Desastres (TS59404).

courses.name: Emergency Pediatric Care (EPC) 4th ed.
courses.objective: Give prehospital health professionals the knowledge and skills needed to effectively assess and manage pediatric patients in emergency situations.

courses.name: Advanced Medical Life Support (AMLS)
courses.objective: Develop the skills to care for patients with clinical emergencies to the highest educational standard for assessment and treatment.

courses.name: Emergency Vehicle Operator Course (COVE)
courses.objective: Provide participants with knowledge of the safety and correct execution of a high-angle rescue or its evacuation.

courses.name: EMS Vehicle Operator Safety (EVOS)
courses.objective: Addresses the knowledge gap that leads to injuries and deaths, focusing on the specific behaviors that must change to create a culture of safe driving.

courses.name: Vertical Rescue Specialist
courses.objective: The participant will be able to implement mechanical advantage systems, tripod use, and zip-line/rescue-line rigging, among many other techniques.

courses.name: Fundamental Critical Care Support (FCCS)
courses.objective: Prioritize the assessment needs of the critically ill patient, select appropriate diagnostic tests, identify and respond to significant changes in the unstable patient, recognize and initiate management of life-threatening acute conditions, and determine the need for specialist consultation.

courses.name: Professional Lifeguard for Pools and Water Parks
courses.objective: The participant will gain the knowledge needed to become a professional lifeguard.

courses.name: Professional Open Water Lifeguard (GPAA)
courses.objective: Provide participants with the knowledge and skills needed to approach and rescue patients in an aquatic environment.

courses.name: HeartCode BLS and/or ACLS
courses.objective: Offers flexible, efficient training for health professionals who need to renew their credentials.

courses.name: Selective Movement Restriction / Selective Immobilization
courses.objective: Provide the participant with the tools to apply and execute selective spinal immobilization and/or spinal movement restriction algorithms based on scientific evidence, patient assessment, and critical-thinking decision-making.

courses.name: Comprehensive Airway Management
courses.objective: Provide evidence-based tools for comprehensive airway management in the prehospital setting and the care of the main pathologies that can affect gas exchange at any level.

courses.name: Comprehensive Management of the Burn Patient
courses.objective: Provide emergency medical technicians with an update on prehospital management of the burn patient, with an emphasis on airway interventions, intravenous fluid management, and thermal control.

courses.name: Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP)
courses.objective: Train health professionals in the comprehensive management of newborns who require life support in the first minutes of life.

courses.name: Instructor Training Program
courses.objective: CECEM offers this instructor training program.

courses.name: NAEMT Retake/Makeup
courses.description: Payment for taking a makeup evaluation on a date other than the original course date.

courses.name: AHA Rescheduling
courses.description: Payment for rescheduling an AHA course.

courses.name: Stop The Bleed
courses.objective: Learn about the types of hemorrhage and techniques to stop them: direct pressure, pressure bandaging, wound packing, Israeli bandages, hemostatic agents, and tourniquets.

courses.name: Vehicle Extraction Technician (TEV)
courses.objective: Provide participants with knowledge of the safety and correct execution of a vehicle rescue in the safest and most effective way, according to the characteristics of the entrapment type.

courses.name: Intravenous Therapy
courses.objective: Use evidence-based medicine to update the treatment used by prehospital personnel, along with the benefits, goals, and consequences of intravenous solutions.

courses.name: TRIAGE and Mass Casualty Management
courses.objective: Train professionals to effectively manage mass-casualty emergencies, equipping them with skills to rapidly triage the injured.

courses.name: Prehospital Ultrasound / Ultrasound-Guided Vascular Access
courses.objective: Incorporate the use of ultrasound as a rapid diagnostic tool in the prehospital setting.

courses.name: Clinical Emergencies
courses.objective: Identify the main updates in the identification and treatment of the various clinical emergencies a health professional may encounter.

courses.name: Obstetric Emergencies
courses.objective: Implement care techniques for gyneco-obstetric patients in emergency situations: diagnosis, treatment, and referral criteria according to current national and international standards.

courses.name: Trauma Emergencies
courses.objective: Update and standardize the approach used by emergency medical professionals to manage the trauma victim, strengthening the development of life-saving skills.

courses.name: Non-Invasive Mechanical Ventilation
courses.objective: Learn to identify the indications, contraindications, and benefits of NIMV, and to select, adjust, and monitor basic ventilation parameters using modern devices and updated protocols.

courses.name: Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation and Airway Obstruction Relief
Act in Time: Learn to Save a Life
courses.description: Would you know what to do in a medical emergency at home, school, or on the street? This workshop is designed to give you the basic tools that can make the difference while professional help arrives.

courses.name: Home Patient Care: Medication Administration and Home Adaptations
courses.description: Aimed at people who need knowledge about the adaptations needed to care for sick family members at home: recommendations for improving mobility and preventing injuries and other adverse conditions.

courses.name: Stretcher-Bearer Training. Safety in Patient Transport and Mobilization
courses.description: Learn the principles of safe patient mobilization (mobile devices, wheelchairs, stretchers) and transfer/mobilization techniques for diagnostic studies within hospital units.

courses.name: Introduction to the Mexican Red Cross
courses.description: Expand your knowledge of the institution's doctrine.

courses.name: Wound Cleaning and Treatment
courses.description: Learn the principles of identifying contaminated wounds and their proper disinfection and cleaning.

courses.name: First Aid (First Responder, 8 hrs)
courses.description: Designed for people who are not health professionals, to give them a first introduction to actions they can take to save the life of an injured or ill person.

courses.name: State Basic-Level Training/Update Program (PEAB)
courses.description: 100% online program; once purchased, access is granted to the site's asynchronous classes and reference materials, with access for 6 months. There are NO start dates, it can be started at any time.

courses.name: CECEM Certificates
courses.description: Pay for the certificate you wish to request and submit the request for issuance. For National Certificates, contact c.escolar@cruzrojacecem.com
